reviews.text: Not sure what changed I have been coming here for years and the past few months my dogs come back with injuries and we are never told about them by the groomer. Time to find another place
Excellent, great service and care.
I’ve taken all 3 of my dogs here throughout their long lives. Appreciate this place so much.

Pros; The groom +bath + nail trim for small dog was only $75 (a low price in the area), they used his medical shampoo that I brought, and the front desk person was nice.

Cons: my dog came back with unevenly cut fur in multiple areas, his nails were very sharp as if they did not file them after cutting, AND he had to wait in a kennel for almost 2 hours, which I was not told would be the case when I made the phone appointment (and told them I was a first time customer).
There is a sign at the store that says it will take 2-3 hours, but customers only see what after the appointment is made if it was made by phone. I did not appreciate that.

I’m beyond grateful to everyone at this grooming salon. Today I brought in 9 dogs that I had just rescued from a terrible situation. They were covered in fleas and ticks and in heartbreaking condition. I walked in without an appointment, hoping for a miracle, and they took every single dog in right away.

Not only did they groom them with so much care, but they also treated all of them for fleas at no extra charge. Seeing these dogs clean, comfortable, and finally able to experience kindness after everything they had been through brought me to tears.

Thank you for your compassion, generosity, and willingness to help when it mattered most. You made a huge difference in these dogs’ lives, and I’ll never forget your kindness. I can’t recommend you enough.
Had an appointment and the owner would not take him unless I gave my dog a pill to calm him down. Then he told me that he didn't have time for him.  This place is not a pet loving location

This is not our usual place as we live hours away and such pity that we had the WORST NIGHTMARE experience here. AVOID AVOID AVOID. The girl workers there are very rude, and we noticed bright red BLOOD stains same day later on our dog’s blanket. This would explain why our dog was Shaking uncontrollably from trauma and PAIN which we were confused to why. NEVER NEVER TAKING OUR DOG TO THIS TRASH ESTABLISHMENT!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! By the way, our dog never shakes after grooming and rarely shakes. We were in the area so regretfully went there. So so upset

WARNING:IFyou love and care about your dog, DoNOT go here. Recently I  took my little 10 month old Shi-tzu,  Binki, in for her summer cut. This was her second grooming, first time was great, 2nd time my spot was busy so we took her here. When we picked her up she was off. She was jumping around biting at her backside,  would not go for walks. We took her back met the owner, who denied any wrong doing, until we put her down to walk. He said OH shit, she needs a vet. I called  to speak to the groomer  who was so rude ,he came at me and blamed  to dog claiming  she was very difficult..we took her to 2 vets , examined  her gave her antibiotics  and pain men's. They were going to do trays for $700 but tge machine was down. Thankfully  now she is ok. NEVER HEARD BACK FROM THEM.!!! NIGHTMARE ON COLORADO.. NOT PUPPY LOVE!! And they messed up the analysis glands. The doctor fixed that. Terrible place, should have read reviews  before  going here

**** BEWARE OF THE NEW FRONT DESK WOMAN WITH CURLY HAIR AND WIRE GLASSES ****

I used to take my girl Juniper (30lbs) to this place all the time to get her nails done. I forget who the old front desk person's name was, but she was kind and the trim would always go smoothly.

A few months ago they got a new person for the front. She seemed nice enough and we had seen her a few times when we'd come. I couldn't help but feel like she didn't have a ton of experience handling dogs, but shook it off as again she seemed nice.

Flash forward to about 3 weeks ago, I took Juniper for her regular nail trim. She is usually hesitant about having her nails done/going to the back, but is always good for it.

Old front desk lady used to pick her up and take her no problem. This new lady had tried to drag her by her collar to the back before, but I picked up Juniper and placed her in her arms.

This time we went, she seemed impatient from the get go. She rushes to take the leash from me after saying a one word "Nails?" and before I could pick Juniper up, proceeds to drag her across to the back as fast as she could, causing Juniper to SLAM HER HEAD on the front desk.

I have searched for an email to send this message to the company privately and have failed to find it. I value small businesses and have since began taking Juniper to another business where her groomer is patient and kind to Juniper and you can tell loves his dogs he grooms.

You may be wondering why this isn't a 1-star; this lady is not the many wonderful groomers that are at Puppy Love. BUT, by hiring her she is the face of your company.

A message to that woman: Think long and hard if you love dogs enough to have your relations with them a career. Do you have the PATIENCE?

Of course there was no compensation, no apology from her.

Puppy Love please sit down with this woman and walk her through the basics of handling our pets. I do not want to see another pet hurt because of someone's ignorance.

Thankfully Juniper is okay and is not traumatized, but after 2 years of going to this establishment 2-3 times a month, I will not be jeopardizing my pet's safety.

They clip nails, shampoo your dog.

Their teeth.

Perfect for your Yorkie/ chow
Perfect for grooming dogs like this grooming spot.

We called and made an appointment for Saturday, June 21st but then they said they’re busy and booked already. So we made an appointment for Sunday, June 22nd  over the phone and when we brought our dog - BAILEY, they confirmed as to what service we want with our dog. We wanted just a shampoo (bathe) no other services like cutting or trimming etc. The Manager in charge (CHLOE) verified and confirmed to us 2-3 times asking what to do with our dog, and we confirmed 2-3 times as well just shampoo only nothing else. Now, when they called to have our dog be picked up, we got surprised that our dog got “summer cut” (TRIMMING) and usually they will call us first before they will do an trying other than shampoo/bathing, this time they didn’t call at all!  Our dog got a haircut/trimmed before last few months ago, and we were waiting to have her hair grow longer so she will look nicer and adorable looking. And now she got another haircut as we did not even request it. We called back again because we were so upset and disappointed and the lady in the front were very rude and did not know how to handle situation like this. She would’ve at least apologize but she already went ahead and wanted to release herself from the situation without explanation and have told us to talk with the owner immediately as she said “I just work here” and hung up the phone even when we were not done talking! We have been going to this place for years  and this never happen before. And when we asked how come our dog got trimmed? Their response was defensive and did not even apologized at the in the beginning and through the whole conversation. They were even covering their own mistake as to what really happened. When you made a mistake the first thing you do as as a customer service or a manager in charge is to “APOLOGIZE” as to what happened. The lady in the front was being rude as well when dealing with loyal customers and giving support that’s bringing business to your establishment. Now, we are going to look for another grooming place just because the manager (CHLOE) did not give importance and apologize to the customer who’s patronizing the establishment for over the years. And we have two dogs that we always bring them here and we just got treated like nothing. Hope the owner (GONZALO) will have to train them better  and to let them know that customers are the ones bringing business. Specially the loyal customers that gives great rating and introducing their business to our family and friends to come to this dog grooming place because of their great service. But unfortunately this has happened and we did not expect to get treated like this. They should’ve immediately apologized and will make it better in the future instead of tearing us like a nobody that keeping the business running. Hopefully other customers won’t get the same treatment as we had experienced with them. This happened last JUNE 22, 2025.

We were not going to put a star at all, but we put 1 star at the least from how they have treated the ongoing and loyal customer.

Excellent service from all the staff. From making Liebchen's appointment to bringing her out after she was groomed, everyone went above and beyond! Will definitely continue taking my fur baby there for her spa days. By the way, very affordable ❤🥰 …

We fell in love with this place and this team! They took such good care of our dog and made her summer ready and listened to all the details of what we thought made sense for her haircut. We previously used a different groomer and they shaved our dog's body clean but left a lot of tail hair and on top of her head. This time she looks and smells perfect. We are very happy and will be back for future haircuts!

Our dogs LOVE this pet spa! I’ve taken our dogs to many groomers over the years in the different places we live & this is one of the few places that they come out happy as a lark. The prices are very reasonable. The groomers are so sweet & take suggestions well. The dogs always come out so cute & well groomed. I’m definitely so glad I found Puppy Love. They definitely treat our puppies with lots of love!

I took my 2 fur babies today, and my mom's fur babie....we couldn't be happier. Been having a hard time finding a good groomer and our search is finally over. Thank you,  to all who groomed Daisy, Violet and Chiquita. They look absolutely beautiful.  We will definitely be coming back.

Only place I take my pups! And I don’t even live full time in LA anymore! When I am here I make it a point to bring the babies to Puppy Love. I’m usually able to make a same day or next day appt, the boys are done in less than 2 hours usually and they always come home smelling so fresh and clean (and staying that way for at least a few weeks!) Bonus is the cute, matching handkerchiefs they’re adorned in after each visit. 100% recommend!

The nicest people and great groomers. Ive watched them groom dogs and they are patient and caring. They talk to your dog and constanly reassure them. I really like the way they handle my girl and she comes out beautiful and happy. No stress

I took my dog in for a basic wash, she was done in one hour. The staff were approachable and friendly over the phone when making an appointment. They gave my dog a little bandana and left her looking fresh. They also welcome walk ins just call ahead to verify.

Parking can sometimes be difficult but it’s rare. The price for my dog’s service was $45 with some add ons. I would recommend to other pet owners.
Amazing Staff! So kind & gentle!

On all fairness, they do a pretty good job of trimming and shampoo. Nails weren't trimmed and the sad part was nicked her chin and ears and wasn't advised.
Found put when I lifted her when we got home. No apologies were made. 😔 …

Always great fast service and good pricing!!!
Benny is nice and fresh when we pick him up!!
